Source inventory — not a complete or current statement of the law. Counts are catalogue records, not guaranteed distinct current laws. Same-title instruments and versions remain separately represented. Collection labels are not verified territorial applicability.

Titles link to existing official sources. Full texts and executable rules are not loaded here. Unknown versions and legal status are retained and labelled, not silently excluded. Commencement, amendments, repeal and applicability require checking against authoritative texts.

Dates: source-snapshot dates describe collection or reconciliation, not legal currency. Catalogue prepared 30 October 2026. Some Sindh titles and citations have been identified from the exact official PDFs; identification does not establish current consolidation.

Separate collections: 39 unresolved Sindh official PDF identities are in source review. 4,834 historical document/version records are listed separately and are not added to the 4,135 titled-source total.
